text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Zambia Independent Media Association condemns the harrassment of journalists by political party supporters at news conferences.
- Residents of a Lusaka township riot on Saturday night following a hit and run road accident in which a resident died.
- Finance Minister Ronald Penza denies reports that the government recently printed money to meet a budget gap caused by western aid cuts.
- Opposition parties urge parliament to expel members who are known to be drug traffickers.
